learn.learn.doneSub: {n} of {of} ayat memorised. Come back tomorrow for the next part, or carry on now.
learn.learn.doneFullSub: It will be thirsty again soon: recite it then, so it stays with you.
learn.learn.firstLesson: Listen first, then practise, then recite it from memory
learn.learn.allDone: You have reached the end of the path. Keep your trees watered.
learn.learn.introAt: Starting with {where}, one ayah at a time
learn.learn.chooseStartAria: Where the path starts and how much at a time
learn.learn.chunkNote: Each lesson learns this much, then links it to what came before.
learn.learn.doneStepSub: Learned. Practise it again whenever you like.
learn.learn.gardenEmpty: Your first tree grows with your first lesson.
learn.learn.knowSub: Tap the surahs you already know. A quick tasmi' of each grows its tree straight away.
learn.learn.lockedSub: Finish the steps before this one first.
learn.learn.newSub: Meaning, listen, repeat, then say it from memory.
learn.learn.quickNotYet: It stays on your path to learn
learn.learn.startHere: Start the path from this surah
learn.learn.startJuzSub: Start from a juz you are reading
learn.learn.startSub: You can change it any time.
learn.learn.startTitle: Where would you like to start?
learn.learn.focusOn: Focus page: the page fills the screen
learn.learn.pmQWhichLine: Which word starts the marked line?
learn.learn.pmQTapLine: Tap the line where it starts
learn.learn.pageSub: You have finished this page. Learn where its lines start, then recite it whole from memory.
learn.learn.similarSub: Some of these ayat look like others in the Quran. See what differs, so they never mix.
learn.learn.chestLocked: Finish the lessons before it to open it.
learn.learn.gateSub: Recite one page of this juz from memory. Pass it and the gate of this juz stands in Your garden.
learn.learn.gateLocked: Grow every tree of this juz to open its checkpoint.
learn.learn.gateDone: The gate of Juz {n} stands in Your garden.
learn.learn.gatePage: Page {p}, the one you hold least firmly
learn.learn.gatePassedSub: The gate of Juz {n} now stands in Your garden.
learn.learn.gateNotYet: Not passed yet. Revise the page and try again.
learn.learn.dayAria: {n} of {of} lessons today. Change the daily target
learn.learn.dayNoneAria: {n} lessons today. Set a daily target
learn.learn.daySetSub: How many lessons a day? This is also your Learn goal on Me, with its own chest.
learn.learn.tasmiSub: The whole surah from memory. It grows the tree in full.
learn.learn.meaningLead: First, what it means. Tap a word to hear it.
learn.learn.qOrderParts: Put the parts of the ayah in order
learn.learn.followHint: Recite aloud: each word appears as you say it.
learn.learn.followSkipped: Words skipped or said differently show in red. Keep going.
learn.learn.followQuiet: The microphone stopped after a quiet moment. Tap Follow my voice to go on.
learn.learn.followLouder: I didn't quite hear that word. No mistake counted: say it a little louder.
learn.learn.followReport: Voice heard me wrong? Tell us
learn.learn.followDenied: The microphone is off for Ayah Studio. Allow it in the phone settings.
learn.learn.followFailed: Speech recognition is not available on this device.
learn.learn.followNoArabic: Your phone's speech recognition has no Arabic yet. Open the Google app (or Settings → Languages → Speech) and add Arabic for voice typing. The button is hidden on this phone for now and comes back in a few days to try again.
learn.learn.followFailedCode: Follow my voice could not start on this phone (code {code}), so its button is hidden here for now. You can still recite and check yourself.
learn.learn.micBusy: Another app is using the microphone. Close it and try again.
learn.learn.followNote: Beta. Your phone turns your voice into text to follow along. No audio or text is kept, only counts of how many words it heard, to improve it. Tap words it got wrong when the text shows.
learn.learn.followNoteServer: Beta. Each part you recite is sent to our server, which follows the words and checks the harakat, then forgets it. Words said with another haraka get an orange wavy line. No audio or text is kept, only counts of how many words it heard, to improve it. Tap words it got wrong when the text shows.
learn.learn.followLimit: That is today's hour of voice checking. It comes back tomorrow.
learn.learn.harakahN: {n} with an orange line: the server heard another haraka. Untap one if you said it right.
learn.learn.helpBody: Share a short clip (up to 3 seconds) of each word it flagged, with your answer, so teachers can check it and the check gets better. Never your name. Change it any time in Me → ⚙.
learn.learn.helpSheetBody: When Follow my voice checks the harakat on our server, share a short clip (up to 3 seconds) of the words it flagged, and a few it did not, with your answer at the check. Teachers listen and label them, and the check gets better for everyone. Your name is never sent with a clip.
